authorization_basis: The operator authorized reasonable compromises needed to launch and authorized fixes to sim-latency or its packages when evidence identifies them.

strict_policy.rule: estimated probability at least 11 of 12 independent no-op results are placeable must be at least 0.95

launch_policy.rule: estimated per-evaluation no-op placeability must be at least 0.94

independent_reference_gate_unchanged.ordering: better paired ratio < no-op paired ratio < worse paired ratio

confidence_disclosure: This launch policy controls the false-rejection probability of one production evaluation; it is not confidence-equivalent to the stricter familywise rule.
